description: This file defines a syntax highlighting mode for the CodeMirror code editor specifically for Handlebars templates, including tokenization rules, mode configuration, and MIME type association.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineSimpleMode
methods.description: Defines a simple syntax highlighting mode for CodeMirror, used here to set up the 'handlebars-tags' mode.

methods.name: CodeMirror.getMode
methods.description: Retrieves a CodeMirror mode object based on configuration, used here to load the base mode and the handlebars mode.

methods.name: CodeMirror.multiplexingMode
methods.description: Creates a mode that combines multiple modes, here used to embed Handlebars parsing within another code mode.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineMode
methods.description: Defines a new syntax highlighting mode, here for 'handlebars'.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineMIME
methods.description: Associates MIME types with modes, here for 'text/x-handlebars-template'.
